def count_in_range(values, low, high, inclusive=True):
    """

    Parameters
    ----------
    values : Iterable[Number]
        The list (or any iterable) of numeric values to test.
    low : Number
        The lower bound of the range.
    high : Number
        The upper bound of the range.
    inclusive : bool, optional
        If True (default) the bounds are inclusive:  low ≤ x ≤ high.
        If False the bounds are exclusive:  low < x < high.

    Returns
    -------
    int
        The number of elements that satisfy the condition.
    """
    if inclusive:
        return sum(low <= x <= high for x in values)
    else:
        return sum(low < x < high for x in values)
